Subject: Finovent evaluation — buying group & technical boundary check

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier today — appreciate you walking us through the payment-reconciliation flow and the three high-level goals (latency under 80ms for critical tokens, deterministic audit trails, and time-to-value for a pilot in Q1). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the buying process and scope aligned before we kick off security intake:

1) Buying group and decision criteria
- Economic buyer: Oliver Grant (confirmed).
- Day-to-day eval lead: Priya Shah (payments product).
- Technical reviewer: Finovent IT Security (security@finovent.com) + SRE (TBD).
- Decision criteria prioritized: security posture (SOC/SecOps), infra boundary (VPC/on-prem constraints), cost per invocation and average latency.

2) Systems in-scope (please confirm):
- Production payment-processing cluster (Kubernetes) — REQUIRED.
- Reporting DB (Postgres) that holds settlements — PROBABLY in-scope for data flow review.
- S3 buckets for ingestion and archived logs — please confirm retention rules.
- Exclude developer workstations and internal analytics dev environment (we assume staging is optional).

3) Security kickoff ask
- I attached a short preliminary security questionnaire (redwood-prelim-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx). If you can route that to security@finovent.com and the SRE owner, we’ll triage the questions and mark items that require evidence (SOC2 cert, KV/CMK usage, data residency).
- Proposed timeline: questionnaire return in 5 business days -> kickoff call week of Dec 8 -> draft MSA/redlines to legal by Dec 22 (targets are flexible).

4) Next actions (owner / ETA)
- Oliver: confirm economic buyer + internal procurement timeline (EOD Thu).
- Priya: confirm which reporting DB host is in-scope and whether PII is present (EOD Thu).
- Finovent IT Security: confirm preferred time for a 30–45 min kickoff and preferred evidence transfer method (SFTP/secure Drive) — target responding by Fri.
- Marissa / Dev (redwood): we’ll prepare the security intake plan and draft a mutually agreed action plan (MAP) after receipt of questionnaire.

If any of the scope bullets above are off, flag them and I’ll update the MAP. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks, Karthik — nice summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming I’m the economic buyer but procurement will sign the final contract (I’ll loop in procurement once legal confirms SLA points).
- Priya confirms the reporting DB (settlements-db.finovent.internal) contains limited PII (hashed identifiers only) — she’ll share a schema snippet.
- Systems: the production Kubernetes cluster, reporting DB, and S3 buckets are in-scope. We will exclude internal analytics dev namespace.

Security contact: forwarding to our security alias (security@finovent.com) and copying in our SRE lead (Amit Rao — amit.rao@finovent.com) on the kickoff scheduling.

Timeline: 5 business days on the questionnaire is OK. For the kickoff, security prefers Dec 9 or Dec 10 in the morning (EST). Our procurement process usually takes 3–4 weeks after legal signs off on commercial terms.

Quick ask: can you provide a short note on your recommended deployment model for our use case (hosted Redwood API vs Dedicated reserved pool vs Private VPC)? We want to include infra recommendation in our internal evaluation pack.

Hi Karthik / Oliver —

We received the questionnaire and did a quick pass. A few items we’d like you to clarify before the kickoff: 

1) Data flow diagram (DFD): please provide a simple DFD that shows where tokens, PII, and KV caches live, and which components hold encrypted material at rest.
2) Key management: confirm whether customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported in Private and Dedicated offerings; provide short notes on integration options.
3) Audit logs and retention: what granularity of request logs do you retain in the Hosted model vs Dedicated, and where are logs stored (region)?
4) Network topology: if we evaluate Private (VPC) what ports/IPs does Redwood require outbound/inbound?

Preferred kickoff windows: Dec 9 09:00–11:00 EST or Dec 10 09:00–11:00 EST. Evidence exchange: we prefer using our secure ShareFile instance; please confirm if that works.

Regards,
Finovent IT Security
security@finovent.com
